C1424.title: Bitcoin Gold (BTG) Hit by 51% Attack, Losing About $18.6 Million
C1424.summary: In May 2018, Bitcoin Gold (BTG) suffered a 51% attack that enabled double-spending on its network, resulting in the theft of over 388,201 BTG worth approximately $18.6 million. The attacker exploited a majority hashrate advantage to double-spend against exchanges, highlighting the vulnerability of low-hashrate blockchain networks.
